## statement
Establish the joint finite-history and output-precision classification C1-C4 for the unknown binary rare-context family D1, using the actual terminal query and a fully charged causal probabilistic predictor. This linked stage consolidates the completed, discussion-reviewed 009 rate work through native evidence and resolves the remaining conditional positive-grid classification. Algebra, project creation, or a single rate lemma alone is not completion.

C1 (statistical prediction). Prove a single (u,t)-independent predictor family with uniform actual-terminal expected KL O(1/N) and conditional-terminal-00 expected KL O(1/(1+Nu)), with explicit universal finite-N constants and all N>=3 branches. Give matching-order full-history lower bounds in the same D1 family, including independent randomized predictors, the terminal-history dependence, and the fixed-law versus triangular-family distinction. The average minimax rate is Theta(1/N); at each fixed u the conditional minimax rate is Theta(1/(1+Nu)), with constants uniform in u. Do not claim a general stationary second-order C/N theorem or ordinary pair-chain reversibility.

C2 (joint history and output precision). For every dyadic Q=2^b>=2, prove that the positive-Q-grid average minimax risk on D1 has order 1/N+1/Q, whereas the positive-Q-grid conditional-terminal-00 minimax risk at each u has order 1/(1+Nu)+1/Q^2. Give finite-N,Q upper and lower inequalities, one unknown-parameter predictor that attains both orders, and explicit treatment of Q=2, Q=4, zero counts, rounding ties and strictly positive exact simplex output. Separate statistical and representation witnesses; max-to-sum constant-factor comparison is allowed but different witnesses must not be called an additive lower bound on one source. The output-format lower bounds do not establish internal precision, depth or architecture lower bounds. The candidate conditional 1/Q^2 result is a new obligation, not an assumed premise.

C3 (actual causal implementation and complete comparison). Realize the attaining predictor with one length-m prefix statistical frontend, a charged actual-terminal query adapter, the distinct prefix endpoint in its flow correction, finite softmax/log/exp/count recovery, integer readout and branch-specific positive quantization. Expose all allowed information and give complete sufficient functions for depth, width, heads, QK dimension, score range, parameter and working bits, masks, positions, holds, offline generation and online bit operations under clearly distinguished cost models. Keep internal count precision Q_A independent of output Q. Include a charged streaming eight-counter baseline and its input model; prove identical output where appropriate without inferring optimized full-network dominance. No uncharged history bypass, free counts, exact transcendental oracle, synthetic extra samples or kernel/process substitution is allowed.

C4 (fixed evidence and scientific synthesis). Integrate C1-C3 into one fixed theorem/proof/implementation package, including real failures and scope corrections; obtain independent fixed-version review, native admissions and root final audit. Compare the strongest obtained claims against pinned primary results at the level of assumptions, risk, quantifiers, estimator and resources. Explain the rare-context/interior versus common-context/near-boundary precision distinction in ordinary Chinese. Report evidence-bounded novelty and remaining mother-problem questions; do not presume publication novelty, neural advantage, practical constants, learnability or noisy-arithmetic reliability.
